label: CLTC::TFE3

sections.text: CLTC encodes clathrin heavy chain, which forms coated vesicles for intracellular transport.
TFE3 encodes a MiT/TFE-family transcription factor that regulates lysosomal and metabolic programs.

The fusion retains the TFE3 DNA-binding and dimerization regions while altering its amino-terminal regulatory architecture, producing abnormal MiT/TFE transcriptional activity. CLTC::TFE3 is a recognized TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma fusion.
